tools.name: style_scan
tools.description: Re-mine the group speaking style from the local event store and write the result into the workspace chain file. With use_model=true a model also summarizes the speaking order for three scenes.

days.description: How many days to look back. Defaults to the configured value.

use_model.description: Also call the model to summarize the speaking order.

summary.zh: 重新统计群里的说话方式，写进思维链关键词块；可选调模型总结说话顺序。
summary.en: Re-mine group speaking style into the chain keywords; optionally summarize the speaking order with a model.

tools.name: style_show
tools.description: Read the style keywords block currently written into the workspace chain file. No statistics are computed.

summary.zh: 读当前写进思维链的语感关键词。
summary.en: Show the style keywords block currently written into the chain.

changelog.0.1.1:
- 补齐扩展市场元数据：`cortico.describe`、`cortico.tags`（`qq` / `experimental` / `requires-key`）、本 CHANGELOG。
- 功能与 0.1.0 相同，为可上架版本。
changelog.0.1.0:
- 首个版本：从本机事件库的 `qq.message` 统计说话方式（句长、标点、口癖、连发、配图比例）。
- 可选调用模型，总结「接梗 / 被问 / 冷场」三种场景的说话顺序。
- 结果写进 `workspace/partner/思维链-通用语感.md` 的托管块，**不占系统前缀**。
- 模型结果缓存到 `workspace/partner/语感-LLM.json`；不调模型或调用失败时沿用缓存，不会被默认值覆盖。
- 工具：`style_scan`（统计 + 可选模型）、`style_show`（只读当前块）。
